notes: "Back at a lab meeting, I will not always tell the same version of the story. Main Slides holds the complete page library. A shorter talk can select some of those pages and arrange them differently. These thumbnails come from the real full and brief presentations in this project. A live reference keeps pointing to the canonical page, so I do not have to maintain two diverging copies."

designIntent.purpose: Back at a lab meeting, I will not always tell the same version of the story.
keep: Keep source figures, labels, measured values and citations
Keep intentional background roles, product identity and meaningful density
designIntent.requestedChange: Use the founder’s account to explain one experience or the design choice it prompted.
